title: cms.form.submitted payload
description:
Published by Abeon CMS when a reader's form submission is accepted. It carries the minimum: no answers, no files, no address. A consumer that needs the answers (Abeon CRM, etap 7b) is given them through its own integration, and every consumer must handle `cms.submission.erased`.

The file name is the routing key.

site_id.description: The CMS site inside the organisation's instance.

form_id.description: The form, the same in every language.

submission_id.description: The submission's public id; the same in the panel's address and in the erasure event.

form_version.description: The published revision of the form the reader saw.

context.description: Where the reader submitted from: a page, or a collection item the reader asked about (a course, a yacht).
